coreMemory.english: v. to have information or understanding about something；v. to be familiar with a person, place, or subject；v. to have learned how to do something；v. to know something so well that you can remember it without help
coreMemory.structure: know the answer /ˈnoʊ ðə ˈænsɚ/（知道答案）；know how to do something /ˈnoʊ ˈhaʊ ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（知道如何做某事）；know about something /ˈnoʊ əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（了解某事）；get to know someone /ˈɡɛt ˈtuː ˈnoʊ ˈsʌˌmwʌn/（逐渐了解某人）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ know how doing something → ✅ know how to do something；❌ know something → ✅ know about something

commonErrors.note: 这个结构要用 know + to + 动词原形；do 只是词卡里的动词占位符，真实句子要换成 finish、check 等具体动词。
在“know about something”这个常用搭配中，介词 about 负责连接后面的对象或范围，不能省略或随意换成其他介词。

coreMemory.example: I know the answer, but I need time to explain it.

synonyms.difference: understand 侧重“理解；明白”。对应的常用英文义是 “to have information, understanding, or familiarity”。know 在本卡搭配“know the answer”中表达“知道”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“知道”这个义项下，ignore（不了解；忽视）与 know 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of know”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。

derivatives.note: 常用于 knowledge of/about，表示对某事的了解。
knowing 是 know 的常用词族形式，作 n. 使用；对应的常用英文义是 “a clear and certain mental apprehension”。
knower 是 know 的常用词族形式，作 n. 使用；对应的常用英文义是 “a person who knows or apprehends”。
